_readme: Copy to data/personas.json to give teams league-written personas for the Gazette. Match a team by its Sleeper team name or the manager's Sleeper username. Every field is optional; anything left out stays auto-generated. voice is one of: showman, ceo, conspiracy, zen, optimist, oldtimer, nerd. quotes are keyed by situation: win, loss, blowoutWin, blowoutLoss, closeLoss, trade, bench, hot, cold, oddsUp, oddsDown. offLimits lists topics the Gazette must never joke about for this team.

teams.bio: Has blamed the app for every loss since 2024. Has never once blamed the app for a win.
teams.signatureMove: Starting a kicker at FLEX on purpose 'to send a message'
teams.nemesisPlayer: Any running back named after a month
teams.mascot: A raccoon in a referee shirt

win: Even a broken algorithm is right twice a season.
blowoutLoss: I was testing a new lineup philosophy. It's called 'no.'
